# Experimental Reference Data

[Project home](../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Validation/calibration reference signals only. RH is measured; LH is mirrored; forelimb references are from a separate study. TABLE_MANIFEST identifies the sampling grid, units and columns.

- [hindlimb_flexor_hallucis_longus_emg.npz](hindlimb_flexor_hallucis_longus_emg.npz) — Numerical flexor hallucis longus EMG reference, with its source sampling information. Used for waveform comparison, not as an imposed activation state.
- [aligned_forelimb_EMG_individual_cycles.npz](aligned_forelimb_EMG_individual_cycles.npz) — Available individual forelimb EMG cycles on the comparison phase grid; the source recordings are from a separate study.
- [paw_contact_initialization.npz](paw_contact_initialization.npz) — Stored source arrays associated with preparing paw contact and the starting state; the live run calculates forces from its current mechanics.
- [Recorded EMG](Recorded_EMG/README.md) — Available measured or pooled EMG envelopes and their provenance. EMG is normalized for shape comparison; it is not a direct measurement of absolute muscle excitation or activation.
- [Ground Reaction Forces](Ground_Reaction_Forces/README.md) — Paw forces in newtons. Fx is anterior–posterior (negative braking, positive propulsion), Fy is lateral and Fz is vertical. Reference forces are comparison targets; simulated forces are calculated from paw contact.
- [hindlimb_pose_initialization.npz](hindlimb_pose_initialization.npz) — Source arrays for constructing the initial hindlimb pose. The applied starting state is recorded in Model_Parameters/initial_state.py.
- [right_hindlimb_walking_reference.npz](right_hindlimb_walking_reference.npz) — Right hindlimb walking reference arrays associated with the selected source trial.
- [INPUT_PROVENANCE.json](INPUT_PROVENANCE.json) — Experimental origin and assumptions for the reference signals.
- [Inverse Estimates](Inverse_Estimates/README.md) — Excitation and activation estimated by the source inverse analysis. They are model estimates, not recorded EMG, and are not the complete 104-channel motor input used in this forward model.
- [Joint Kinematics](Joint_Kinematics/README.md) — Joint-angle and motion tables. Reference tables describe the comparison target; result tables contain predicted motion. Each filename or column specifies whether angles are in radians or degrees.
- [hindlimb_forelimb_reference_cycles.npz](hindlimb_forelimb_reference_cycles.npz) — Named arrays of the hindlimb and forelimb comparison cycles, including their phase convention and reference signals.
- [TABLE_MANIFEST.json](TABLE_MANIFEST.json) — Reference file paths, units, array shapes and phase convention.
